archival_memory.sibling_relationship_dynamic: The younger sibling(age 10) and older brother(age 14) have a brilliant, sharp relationship characterized by professional divergence and mutual support. The 14-year-old is obsessed with engineering and the 10-year-old still figuring out the world—yet they both share an infectious competitive spirit and want to see each other succeed. My running joke that I handle "old money" while they focus on building the future adds to this balance. They're always pitching me some AI-driven fintech startup, and I counter with a lesson on risk management—it’s a great dynamic we push each other to think differently. It’s rare to have a sibling relationship that blends business insight with mutual respect, and I don’t take it for granted.
